in_marathi.name: Hansika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Hansa's delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hansika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Named after Goddess Hansa, the embodiment of compassion and peace. She is depicted with swan as her vehicle and is known to protect and nourish her devotees.
